title: clematis orientalis f. massoniana
intro: Clematis orientalis f. massoniana, commonly known as Chinese Clematis, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and lowering fever. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic effects, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Clematis orientalis f. massoniana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
